method: s265 (wolf-lang#918). bench-gates builds corpus/hello.lu on the release tier with the gauntlet's own driver (target/debug/wolf --release --no-cache) and bench/startup/hello.c with the host's clang -O2, traces each once with `strace -qq -o`, and counts the system calls from the one after execve to exit_group (exit lines excluded). The wolf count minus the C count is the runtime's own start-up and exit; the dynamic loader's calls appear in both. Gated: may not rise above this number; `cargo xtask bench-gates --record` ratchets it down. The wall half (50 interleaved starts of each, the medians and the ratio) is printed report-only.
recorded: kasumi, s265, ubuntu:24.04 container (glibc 2.39, clang 18.1.3), linux 7.2.8: wolf 51 calls, C 35. For scale, the published release archives' hello (the same count): 0.2.34 41 calls, 0.2.35 58.
